property: Attributed human statement-fidelity review of the absolute-K answer-slot repair.
question: Does the repaired Erdős 887 declaration express the source question using one absolute constant K outside the C and n binders?
procedure: Read the English source question in the exact base file and identify the quantifier order: one absolute K, then every C greater than zero, then all sufficiently large n.
Apply or inspect the exact retained repair and check that the existential K sits outside the C and n binders.
Check that the interval, divisor predicate, number types, and eventual quantifier still match the source question within the declaration's stated scope.
Check whether the answer(sorry) equivalence is the intended Formal Conjectures encoding of this open yes-or-no question rather than a proof of the question itself.

Record pass only if the repaired declaration is source-faithful within this scope. Record fail for a concrete mismatch, inconclusive when the available source or encoding convention cannot settle the comparison, and error when the review could not run.
required_witness: Name the exact clause that places K outside C and n. For fail or inconclusive, name the first disputed source or declaration clause.

environment.independence: The reviewer must be a human who did not prepare the repair, execution result, or source-audit finding. Shared use of the public source, retained repair, and this method must be disclosed on the Verification Record.

does_not_establish: A passing review does not prove Erdős problem 887 or discharge any sorry.
A passing review does not establish a from-source dependency build or an independent mechanical reproduction.
Verification does not accept the Proposal or change Math Standing; an authorized human Decision remains separate.
